item.title: (4,7) buckets
item.description: One of these days a friend mentioned this internet puzzle, which can be stated as follows: You have two buckets. One bucket with a capacity of 4 L, and another with 7 L. Using only these two buckets, you are asked to obtain exactly 6 L of water.
